name: Lavande Ambre Profond — Parallel A
claim: A literature-bounded, exact product-mass design and conditional stock realization; no sensory, clone, liking, safety or release superiority.

locked_brief.text: Fine lavender clearly recognizable over deep but subordinate mineral-warm amber, restrained resin/hay texture, transparent wood and clean musk. An independent interpretation of the frozen reconstructed Parallel A brief, not a recovery of the missing original R4/R5 prompt.
locked_brief.temporal_goal: Opening identity -> coherent heart -> subordinate supportive drydown; not a measured trajectory

chassis.mobile_sockets: Trace modifiers, texture support and competing musk/amber alternatives only within this brief
chassis.omission_plan: Compare LEAD with SOFTER_AMBER before calling Ambrox excessive. Compare MINIMALIST_CONTROL if resin/hay feels muddy. Compare a carrier-matched Romandolide omission before trying another musk. If medicinal, test less spike lavender rather than deleting the natural core.

decision_changes: Fix the natural lavender block at 34% total: 23.8% Bontoux and 10.2% Aroma&More, exactly 70:30 by mass. This does not claim equivalence to the older 71.875:28.125 nominal-volume ratio.
Keep Ambrox as 300 mg crystals per 6 g product target. There is no crystal uL conversion and no guessed fixed TEC addition.
Choose Romandolide alone for the lead. Habanolide is a separate replacement/omission experiment, not automatically richer.
Resolve AIMI to the owned PW 3IW00300 Alpha Isomethyl Ionone. It is not the stale Givaudan label, Gamma Coeur or Alpha Irone.
Remove redundant Cedrat, retain the small resin/hay layer and do not add superambers, vanilla or a generic floral bouquet.

pareto.selection_reason: Qualitative design coverage and practical stock accounting, not demonstrated sensory superiority

accounting.concentration_definition: 20% by undiluted perfumery-product-equivalent mass, not 20% identified odorant or stock volume

finished_options.ethanol: q.s. measured final 30.00 mL after dissolution and equilibration

accounting.ethanol_96_percent_as_supplied: Count as solvent product mass; strength basis not silently converted to absolute-ethanol mass

small_sample.extra_alcohol_rule: If a grams of dissolution ethanol enters the master, aliquot (stock_total+a)/6 and add 5-(stock_total+a)/6 grams ethanol; never count a twice.

stock_notes: All lead ingredients have current owned mappings. Labdanum, coumarin, olibanum and hay have explicit w/w fractions, so direct weighing needs no density conversion. The PW olibanum resinoid base includes supplier carrier; its product target is not pure frankincense-resin mass. R5 and R6 remain unchanged. Neither the old nor new Parallel A is assumed physically mixed.
stock_preparations: No new dilution is required for the displayed 6 g product batch. The smallest stock charges are 0.018 g (18 mg). Use a homogeneous master aliquot for a small final sample rather than weighing the trace ingredients at one-sixth scale.
The four current mass stocks carry exactly 1.068 g added DPG: labdanum 0.432 g, coumarin 0.324 g, olibanum 0.096 g, hay 0.216 g. The whole physical stock master is 7.068 g, not 6 mL.
mixing_order: Weigh Hedione, Iso E Super, Romandolide and the pale-wood scaffold.
Add the four known w/w resin/hay/coumarin stocks and the owned PW AIMI product.
Dissolve 300 mg crystal Ambrox using part of the final ethanol allowance, preserving that alcohol in the ledger.
Add the two lavender products, linalyl acetate, ethyl linalool, clary and spike lavender; add bergamot, petitgrain and juniper last. Close, mix and inspect.

stop_conditions: target stock cannot be weighed reliably
